title: Stale .ics import plan can resurrect a shift another device deleted, or clobber a concurrent edit, and the result gets persisted to the cloud
where: index.html:3147-3191 (icsConfirmImport), 3089-3105 (buildIcsImportPlan closes over live `shifts`/`dayEvents`), 1511-1543 (icsPlanFromExisting captures shiftType/bonusType/hours at plan-build time), 2547-2574 (15s cross-device poll calls applyData which does a full setShifts(d.shifts) overwrite)
detail: The .ics import/sync merge plan (`toUpdate`, with `prevShiftId`/`shiftType`/`bonusType`/`hours` frozen into `icsImport` state) is built once, from whatever `shifts`/`dayEvents` happened to be in scope at parse time (a manual file import, or `runIcalSync`'s up-to-12s proxy fetch). The user then reviews a multi-step questionnaire before tapping Confirm — this can take anywhere from seconds to a minute or more for several shift groups. During that whole window the independent cross-device sync poll (index.html:2547-2574) keeps running every 15s while the tab is visible, and on finding a newer cloud row calls `applyData(row.data,{keepPeriod:true})`, which does an unconditional `setShifts(d.shifts)` (index.html:2317) — a full state replacement, not a merge. When the user finally taps Confirm, `icsConfirmImport`'s `setShifts(prev=>...)` (3163) operates on whatever `prev` is *now* (post-poll), but for every `toUpdate` entry it unconditionally does `dropShift(u.prevDateKey,u.prevShiftId)` (no-op if that id is already gone) and then unconditionally re-inserts `{id:u.prevShiftId, shiftType:u.shiftType, hours:u.hours, ...}` (3171-3176) using the values captured at plan-build time — with no check that the shift still exists, is still at the state the plan assumed, or wasn't intentionally deleted/edited elsewhere in the meantime.
failure: Nurse has BadgeBudget open on her phone and signed in on a tablet too (the app's advertised two-device use case). On the phone she opens Settings and taps 'Sync now' (or the silent app-open auto-sync fires and finds something to confirm), which opens the import questionnaire with several shift groups to classify. While she's still working through the cards, she deletes a shift on the tablet (it got cancelled) and it saves to the cloud. Within 15s the phone's background poll pulls that newer blob and removes the shift from `shifts` there too. She finishes the questionnaire on the phone and taps Confirm: `icsConfirmImport`'s stale `toUpdate` entry for that same icsUid re-adds the shift she just deleted on the tablet, with its old id/date/hours/pay type. The debounced save effect (2453-2487) then pushes this reconstituted shift back to Supabase, overwriting — permanently, last-writer-wins — the deletion she made on the other device. The same mechanism also silently reverts a pay-type/hours edit made on the other device mid-sync, since the plan's `shiftType`/`bonusType`/`hours` were snapshotted before that edit landed.
fix: Re-derive (or at least re-validate) the merge plan against the current `shifts`/`dayEvents` at Confirm time rather than trusting the snapshot captured when the sheet opened — e.g. re-run `buildIcsImportPlan` (or just check that `u.prevShiftId` still exists at `u.prevDateKey` with the same fields) inside the `setShifts` functional updater, and drop/re-warn on any `toUpdate`/`toRemove` entry whose target shift already vanished or changed for a reason other than this sync.
